ambiguities.text: The specification does not define the exact format of SCO files or the directory structure for scanning.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume SCO files are JSON with defined schema, stored in client-specific configuration directories. This needs verification from implementation.

ambiguities.text: The term 'unsafe operations' in verification scripts is not precisely defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'unsafe operations' includes: network access, arbitrary file writes, wallet operations, and non-deterministic behavior.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify what happens if multiple SCOs target the same block.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume SCOs targeting the same block are executed in order of discovery/registration, and conflicts cause entire block recovery to abort.

implicit_assumptions.description: The SCO files in designated directories have been vetted through the governance process before deployment.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious SCO files could execute unauthorized state changes, transferring funds or deploying malicious contracts.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes in the network implement the same SCO actions at the same block height.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network consensus failure if nodes disagree on state changes, potentially causing a chain split.

implicit_assumptions.description: The filesystem containing SCO files has not been tampered with by an attacker.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attacker could inject malicious SCO files to steal funds or corrupt state.
